Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to lock in the annual prepay for 2027 but need a clear tranche-release schedule and VAT ownership split per country to get the PO and treasury sign-off.

Two asks from our side before we issue the PO:
- A sample invoice cadence that maps to a staircase release (monthly or quarterly is fine) with expected ledger dates.
- A concise VAT responsibility table (which entity issues the invoice, which party is responsible for VAT filing/evidence) for UK, DE, FR, and NL.

I've attached a draft PO and our estimated usage file — please review and confirm any changes needed on Redwood's end. Procurement will need the specific invoice remit name and VAT ID that will appear on the invoice to route the PO correctly.

Hi all — attaching the two invoice cadence prototypes and the VAT ID list we will use. Key notes:
- Redwood will issue invoices from Redwood Inference Ltd (UK) for UK customers; VAT ID: GB123456789.
- For Germany, France, and Netherlands we will use Redwood Inference GmbH / SARL / B.V. respectively; VAT IDs included in the spreadsheet.
- For the quarterly tranche option we recommend an "invoice-to-drawdown" mapping where each quarter invoice equals the committed tranche release; this reduces small reconciliations.

Operational asks for Acme procurement:
1) Confirm preferred cadence (monthly vs quarterly).
2) Confirm remit name and which entity you require on AP systems for each country.
3) If you need us to change invoice numbering to match your PO schema, provide an example.

Attachment: prepay_schedule_variants_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Megan Li <finance@acme-analytics.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Prepay cadence: schedule variants and VAT IDs

Thanks Kimberly, Chloe — we reviewed the two prototypes with treasury. A few follow-ups:
- We prefer the quarterly tranche release to minimize ledger churn.
- For UK and DE invoices we'd like Redwood Inference Ltd and Redwood Inference GmbH respectively; please confirm the exact remit name strings so our AP team can map banks/VAT.
- On VAT responsibility: Acme will accept vendor invoices and account for VAT domestically; however we need the supplier-side VAT evidence (tax point + invoice copy) within 7 days of invoice date for our filing.

Also looping in Hugo from BigRetail — they are our EU data center partner and asked whether we can include a single consolidated invoice per quarter for multi-country usage. Is that possible or do you need separate invoices per Redwood legal entity?

Action items: Chloe/Kim — can you send the final quarterly invoice template and the remit strings today? Procurement will prep the PO once received.

Best,
Megan

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Final: Quarterly tranche template + remit strings (Acme)

Hi Megan / Hugo / Procurement,

Attached is the final quarterly invoice template and the remit name + VAT ID table we will use. Summary of decisions included in the template header:
- Invoices will be issued quarterly per Redwood legal entity where the consumption occurred.
- We will provide a consolidated PDF bundle each quarter with one invoice per entity plus a summary csv for your ledger team (this satisfies the single-bundle ask while preserving entity-level VAT compliance).
- Redwood will upload tax evidence (invoice copies and tax point metadata) to the shared Drive folder within 48 hours of invoice generation.
- Unused prepay at quarter close: we will reconcile and either credit the following quarter or process a wire at Acme's preference (both options are supported; indicate preference on the PO).

Remit strings (exact):
- Redwood Inference Ltd – Redwood Inference Ltd (VAT GB123456789) 
- Redwood Inference GmbH – Redwood Inference GmbH (VAT DE987654321)
- Redwood Inference SARL – Redwood Inference SARL (VAT FR192837465)
- Redwood Inference B.V. – Redwood Inference B.V. (VAT NL564738291)

Next steps (for Acme):
- Confirm quarterly cadence and PO preference for credit vs wire for unused prepay.
- Procurement to sign PO and return the signed copy (we will countersign the MSA).

Attachments: signed_MSA.pdf (countersign pending), quarterly_invoice_template_acme_v1.pdf

Thanks — will follow up with the Drive link and DocuSign envelope for countersignature.
